requirement_evidence.evidence: Report structures problem formulation, sensor streaming context, frozen SmallCNN1D graph, and 11-margin output specifications prior to implementation details.
Described StreamingMethodAdapter interface, five candidate geometries (box, wave, affine hull, zonotope, random basis), and lifecycle profiles.
All 24 original hypotheses (H01-H24) fully documented with formal verdicts, primary empirical witnesses, and baseline dispositions.
Extracted numerical tables directly from comparison_matrix.csv and hypotheses.csv generated under run week4_initial_20261103 without alteration.
Maintained strict separation between mathematical real-number theorems and Float32 silicon execution. Declared KNOWN_TEST_EXPLORATORY exposure level.
Cited verified primary sources in refs.bib (Reyes-Ortiz 2016, Zhang 2018, Gowal 2018, Xu 2020, Xiang 2026, Kechris 2024, Huang 2026).
Evaluated H24 trilemma conjunction per method, concluding NOT_ESTABLISHED with 0 of 17 methods satisfying Soundness, Useful Coverage, and Net Speedup.
